## florence-shopper-image-blueprint

**Skill:** /shopper-interrogator (Skill 3) — final node in the chain.
**Trigger:** POST webhook with `x-florence-secret` header

Claude turns ranked objections into a markdown image brief: one image per objection, sequenced by rank, with concept + expected lift annotations from the 52-tactic library.

**Input shape:**
```json
{
  "asin": "B07XYZ4231",
  "asin_context": { "title": "...", "category": "...", "current_main_image_url": "..." },
  "ranked_objections": [
    { "rank": 1, "text": "...", "pp_share": 0.42 },
    { "rank": 2, "text": "...", "pp_share": 0.21 }
  ]
}
```

**Output shape:**
```json
{
  "asin": "B07XYZ4231",
  "blueprint_markdown": "# Image stack for B07XYZ4231\n\n## Slot 2 — ...\n..."
}
```

**External dependency:** Anthropic API. Uses `Florence — Anthropic API` credential. Recommended model: `claude-opus-4-7` (output quality matters more than latency here).
